items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: on that show was Jack Dempsey. He died not long ago. This news commentator, personality.

ctx.x: And she got us on the 24-hour show that was going on. There was a benefit, and on that show was Jack Dempsey. He died not long ago. This news commentator, personality. Oh, shoot. Well, you've got to forgive me. I just can't help it. Sometimes I can see his face just as plain as day, and yet I can't call his name for the matter.
